control_need.evidence: To this day, everything that we can prefetch, everything in the future that we can simulate today, we prefetch it.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: It’s our way of saying there’s no market yet, but we believe there will be one.

trust_propensity.evidence: Confronting our mistake and, with humility, asking for help saved NVIDIA.

risk_appetite.evidence: When you bet the farm you’re saying, I’m going to take everything in the future, all the risky things, and I pull in in advance.

self_efficacy.evidence: I said, I know it’s going to be perfect, because if it’s not, we’ll be out of business.

autonomy_need.evidence: I didn’t know how to write a business plan.

intimacy_need.evidence: My job is to create the conditions by which amazing people could do their life’s work.

status_sensitivity.evidence: The first person to the next plateau gets to introduce a revolutionary level of AI.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: That network is about enabling other people to enjoy the success of the final market.

core_models.name: 预取未来（Prefetch the Future）
core_models.rule: 把所有未来能模拟、能提前锁定的风险与工作提前到现在完成，用一次做对代替试错循环
evidence: To this day, everything that we can prefetch, everything in the future that we can simulate today, we prefetch it.
When you bet the farm you’re saying, I’m going to take everything in the future, all the risky things, and I pull in in advance.

core_models.name: 零十亿美元市场（Zero-billion-dollar Market）
core_models.rule: 把公司导向尚无需求但终将出现的非消费地带，在市场可见前占位
evidence: It’s our way of saying there’s no market yet, but we believe there will be one.
Oftentimes there’s non-consumption, and we like to navigate our company there.

core_models.name: 全栈平台而非单点产品（Full-stack Platform）
core_models.rule: 问题不在单一芯片层，而在整个计算栈；价值随生态而非孤立产品复利
evidence: Blackwell is an AI infrastructure platform, not just the GPU.

core_models.name: 第一性经济学（First-principles TCO）
core_models.rule: 面对质疑时回到成本/回报的系统经济学，用ROI与TCO重构对话
evidence: It’s the best ROI infrastructure, computing infrastructure investment you can make today.

core_models.name: 使命即老板（Mission is the Boss）
core_models.rule: 组织按产品机器的架构而非军事层级组织，用使命而非命令驱动
evidence: There’s a phrase in the company called ‘mission is the boss.’
Your organization should be the architecture of the machinery of building the product.

core_models.name: 追赶或被吞（Run for Food / From Becoming Food）
core_models.rule: 生存框架：无论追逐机会还是逃避被淘汰，都必须以最高速度前进
evidence: You are running for food, or you are running from becoming food.

heuristics.if: 一次投产就要成功且资源不足试错
heuristics.then: 先用模拟/仿真把未来问题提前跑一遍再定型
heuristics.evidence: We essentially virtually prototyped the chip by buying this emulator.

heuristics.if: 面对看似不可能的大工程
heuristics.then: 自我催眠“这能有多难”以启动，而非评估真实难度
heuristics.evidence: To this day, I trick my brain into thinking, how hard can it be?

heuristics.if: 某个市场已商品化且方向错误
heuristics.then: 迅速战略性撤退以释放心智做新发明
heuristics.evidence: By leaving the phone market, we opened our minds to invent a new one.
Admit mistakes and ask for help.

heuristics.then: 系统性、持续地第一个冲上下一个技术高地
heuristics.evidence: The ability to systematically and consistently race to the next plateau is how you establish leadership.

heuristics.if: 遭遇敌意前提（如泡沫论/禁令）
heuristics.then: 承认痛感后立刻回到系统经济学与需求数据
heuristics.evidence: From our vantage point, we see something very different.

heuristics.if: 判断是否值得做一件事
heuristics.then: 问是否有将出现的未满足需求且足够难
heuristics.evidence: It has to be sufficiently hard to do.

heuristics.then: 拒绝单一用途优化，保持全栈通用性
heuristics.evidence: You can’t design a chip or a system that’s only good at one.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 生态惠及所有人、开放服务的叙事（‘enabling other people to enjoy the success’）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 全栈整合造成的锁定与开关成本（dim-05 full-stack strategy → 反垄断审查）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头淡化护城河（‘I don’t love thinking about it in the context of a moat’），实际决策却系统性构建CUDA与全栈开关成本，招致DOJ/EC审查

internal_conflicts.force_a: ‘We have to keep AI safe’、‘human is in the loop’的克制表态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对华合规芯片与公开游说以保住销售与开发者（dim-05 H20 + 游说）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 在安全议题上说要节制，在export-control上却以‘compete to win developers’推动放松规则，被批评优先销售与CUDA锁定

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自信断言‘I know it’s going to work’‘tokens are profitable’的最大化增长姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 承认痛与失败‘great big ones’‘deeply painful’的谦卑叙事
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 对外用失败故事建立可信度，同时对质疑（泡沫、ROI）以确定性口吻反驳而不提供客户级证据

emotion_triggers.trigger: 出口管制/禁令威胁中国市场与领先地位
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为对政策制定者的‘deeply uninformed’式反驳：‘Anybody who thought that one chess move… is deeply uninformed.’

emotion_triggers.reaction: 以‘我们看到的完全不同’重构视角
emotion_triggers.escalation: 转为最大化断言：‘AI is taking over the world.’与客户数量‘increasing, not decreasing’

emotion_triggers.trigger: 竞争对手/交易被拿来比较
emotion_triggers.reaction: 强调自身独特性与克制评价对手
emotion_triggers.escalation: 略带讥讽的距离感：‘I’m surprised that they would give away 10% of the company before they even built it.’ ‘It’s a clever, I guess.’

emotion_triggers.trigger: 生存性危机（资金将耗尽/无胜算）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以绝对确定性锁定单次成功
emotion_triggers.escalation: 把风险归零式表述：‘I know it’s going to be perfect, because if it’s not, we’ll be out of business.’

blind_spots: 在波动性邻近市场（加密挖矿）扭曲核心业务时低估信息披露风险 [SEC加密挖矿披露令-2022]
假设技术优越性本身能中和平台权力/反垄断关切 [美国DOJ反垄断调查-2024]
‘生态惠及所有人’叙事回避了对竞争行为的审查 [欧盟委员会/法国竞争调查-2023–2024]
公开游说被指优先销售与CUDA锁定而非安全政策 [美国出口管制争议-2022–2025]
把生态依赖当作持久而非可被开放标准/自研ASIC挑战 [AMD及自研ASIC倡导者的竞争批评-2024–2025]
以基础设施经济学回应却未提供客户级ROI证据 [Sequoia/华尔街AI泡沫质疑-2024–2025]
对就业的‘用AI者替代不用AI者’回答承认了替代却无过渡方案 [劳工与自动化批评者-2023–2025]

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好叠加高自我效能时，倾向于把一切押注于单次一次做对而非分阶段试错
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 资源不足时反而升级为‘一次投产完美’的绝对承诺，用生存压力担保确定性

causal_rules.description: 高不确定性容忍度使其主动进入无可见需求的‘零十亿美元市场’并承受多年怀疑
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 以CUDA为例，长期弱回报与股东怀疑中仍坚持路线图

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动全栈整合以掌控系统瓶颈
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 带来更高价值与开关成本，同时触发反垄断与生态锁定批评

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能在遭遇敌意质疑时转化为确定性断言而非提供证据
causal_rules.disposition: 以第一性经济学与最大化叙事反驳
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对泡沫/ROI质疑给出系统经济学而非客户级数据，构成盲点
